solution:
"""
URL: https://leetcode.com/problems/next-greater-element-iii/description/?envType=problem-list-v2&envId=vn57k9wr

556. Next Greater Element III

Given a positive integer n, find the smallest integer which has exactly the same digits existing in the integer n and is greater in value than n. If no such positive integer exists, return -1.

Note that the returned integer should fit in 32-bit integer, if there is a valid answer but it does not fit in 32-bit integer, return -1.

Example 1:

Input: n = 12
Output: 21

Example 2:

Input: n = 21
Output: -1

Constraints:

    1 <= n <= 2^31 - 1
"""


class Solution:
    def nextGreaterElement(self, n: int) -> int:
        digits = list(str(n))
        i = len(digits) - 2

        # Find the first digit that is smaller than the digit next to it from the right
        while i >= 0 and digits[i] >= digits[i + 1]:
            i -= 1

        if i == -1:
            return -1

        # Find the smallest digit on right side of i-th digit which is greater than digits[i]
        j = len(digits) - 1
        while digits[j] <= digits[i]:
            j -= 1

        # Swap
        digits[i], digits[j] = digits[j], digits[i]

        # Reverse the digits after i
        digits[i + 1 :] = reversed(digits[i + 1 :])

        result = int("".join(digits))
        if result > 2**31 - 1:
            return -1
        return result


sol = Solution()

print(sol.nextGreaterElement(12))  # 21

assert sol.nextGreaterElement(12) == 21
assert sol.nextGreaterElement(21) == -1

assert sol.nextGreaterElement(1) == -1
assert sol.nextGreaterElement(111) == -1
assert sol.nextGreaterElement(1999999999) == -1
assert sol.nextGreaterElement(123456789) == 123456798
assert sol.nextGreaterElement(987654321) == -1
assert sol.nextGreaterElement(2147483476) == 2147483647
assert sol.nextGreaterElement(2147483647) == -1
assert sol.nextGreaterElement(1234321) == 1241233
assert sol.nextGreaterElement(54321) == -1
assert sol.nextGreaterElement(115) == 151
assert sol.nextGreaterElement(999999999) == -1
assert sol.nextGreaterElement(120) == 201
